official_sources: HSE hazardous substances smart forms FAQ
Control of Major Accident Hazards Regulations 2015

official_measurement_examples.name: Consent threshold context
official_measurement_examples.fact: Hazardous substances consent is required for specified substances at or above controlled quantities subject to aggregation rules and exemptions; threshold presence alone does not decide planning permission.

official_measurement_examples.name: Hazardous substances authority
official_measurement_examples.fact: Applications are made to the hazardous substances authority, usually the local planning authority; HSE is a statutory consultee and does not itself grant the consent.

official_measurement_examples.name: HSE consultation zones
official_measurement_examples.fact: HSE assessment can produce inner, middle and outer consultation zones around a consented establishment; a zone intersection is risk-advice context, not an automatic refusal boundary.

official_measurement_examples.name: Advisory role
official_measurement_examples.fact: Government guidance states the COMAH competent authority advice is advisory and does not itself direct refusal of planning permission or hazardous substances consent.

official_measurement_examples.name: Consent stack separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Hazardous substances consent can be required whether or not associated planning permission is needed, and an environmental permit can also be separately required.

official_measurement_examples.name: COMAH versus HSC
official_measurement_examples.fact: COMAH operator duties and hazardous substances planning consent are related major-hazard controls but are legally distinct regimes with different tests and authorities.

official_measurement_examples.name: Current enforcement context
official_measurement_examples.fact: Environment Agency COMAH offence guidance was updated 24 April 2026; enforcement status or notification status must retain current operator and establishment context.

official_measurement_examples.name: Parcel limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Hazard contours and establishment records do not determine parcel ownership, exact development capacity or final planning balance and must not be promoted while recovery is parked.

core_rules: hazardous substances threshold is not planning permission
HSE consultation zone is not automatic refusal
HSE advice is not the consent decision
hazardous substances consent is distinct from planning permission
environmental permit is distinct from hazardous substances consent
COMAH duties are distinct from HSC
historic consent must retain continuation variation revocation context
hazard contour is not land ownership evidence
hazard zone does not calculate parcel yield
no parcel hazardous-substances clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
source_verification_note: Official HSE, Environment Agency, GOV.UK and legislation.gov.uk sources checked on 2026-07-26. Current HSE land-use planning service and April 2026 COMAH enforcement update retained with consent, consultation-zone, COMAH, planning and environmental-permit separation; no parcel promotion.
